CreateProcessDefinitions (REQ-027's own migration) is named, matching the design doc's and TEST-DESIGNER's claim. Reverted myself (`if true do` -> `if prefix() do`), confirmed `git diff priv/repo/migrations/20260816193001_create_process_definitions.exs` empty (exit 0, no output) and `git status --short` shows no tracked-file changes (only this new handoff file, untracked), re-ran the same test -> '13 tests, 0 failures, 12 excluded', pass restored. Checked test/specs/REQ-027.md's 'Regression note' subsection (lines 142-187) line-by-line against my own independent output above: every quoted number (13 tests/1 failure/12 excluded on fail, 13 tests/0 failures/12 excluded on pass, 4 properties/653 tests/0 failures full suite, 14 tests/0 failures for migrations_test.exs alone) and the full CreateProcessDefinitions candidate list match my own reproduction verbatim -- the note is accurate, not just asserted. Fixtures are per-test (own Tenant/schema/Registration row per the file's setup block read at lines ~260-277), no shared mutable state, no test-ordering dependency observed. All six acceptance criteria on this handoff are independently satisfied.
